question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 1
solution:
The correct answer is option (4) i.e. **'On'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the the sentence: She should say to parents who request guidance------------(1) getting their child "school ready''.
 
• **Let's take a look at the options:**
 
 
• **At:** used for small place of a particular type,it is also used with some phrases like at dawn,at dusk,at the door etc.
 
 
• **Example:-** I live **at** Indira nagar in Gorakhpur.
 
 
 
• **To: **used as preposition of direction or it also used before destination places.
 
 
• **Example:-** Raju goes** to **temple.
 
 
 
• **Of: **used for showing possession over the things.
 
 
• **Example: **The gate **of **the school is very big in size.
 
 
 
• **On:** used between two things that touch each other, it also used with some phrases like on get,on monday, or used used as a fix preposition etc.
 
 
• **Example: **They hurried up** on **getting the bus.
 
 
 
 
 
• Here, we can see rest options except **On **will not give a proper meaning.
 
• **On getting** is a fix preposition pattern that means to become successful in doing any work.

Thus the sentence will be- ***She should say to parents who request guidance on__ getting their child "school ready".***

Therefore, the correct answer will be option no.** (4)**
